panels.description: Ada places the archive recorder between Leona and herself in the civic archive. Keep the upper table clear.
Ada turns the recorder toward Leona while Leona faces the public record. Keep the upper recorder clear.
Leona places her sage-gold Covenant band on the public table and states an obligation; keep the band and table clear.
Bi11bot opens his fitted chest compartment and carefully retrieves Adrian's gold-and-burgundy Covenant band; its band is visibly stored, not conjured. Keep the upper compartment clear.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Don’t apologize where it costs nothing.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Put your name on what you do next.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: Review every decision I make. Remove me if I hide one.
